jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (EdTech & AI)
Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
jobs.description:
Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes.

  • Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher.

  • Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route.

  • Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends.

  • Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as déjà vu ce que l’automatisation des flux ou un algorithme de prévision change sur un produit supply chain ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l’IA partout.


👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 42.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.



👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux avec un passage par la supply chain, la logistique, le transport international ou les référentiels de données critiques.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans des architectures fonctionnelles denses et des modèles de données interconnectés, avec une exigence forte sur la qualité de la donnée. Le pilotage de roadmap et de backlog fait partie de ton quotidien, et ton orientation valeur est ton moteur.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une communication capable d’embarquer des interlocuteurs internationaux et dispersés, et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

  • Anglais professionnel attendu.

  • Environnement technique que tu croiseras : Jira, Confluence, Figma, data lakes, API REST, écosystèmes ERP et TMS.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche

Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.

jobs.title: Product Manager Website (m/w/d) - Germany
jobs.description:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Dein Team und Umfeld

Pennylane wächst international: Nach Frankreich bauen wir unsere Websites und Conversion-Funnels für Spanien, Deutschland und die USA aus. Deutschland ist dabei ein strategischer Fokusmarkt. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du entwickelst die deutsche Website als eigenständiges Produkt weiter – mit einem klaren Blick auf den Markt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Bedürfnisse.

Du wirst Teil unseres Website-Teams im Bereich Growth und berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth. Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineers und Designern arbeitest du in einer festen Squad. Dabei bist du täglich mittendrin, packst selbst mit an und bringst Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team live.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com. Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.

Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Conversion optimieren und kontinuierlich experimentieren

  • Du entwickelst die Conversion-Strategie für den deutschen Funnel – von der Startseite über Preis- und Produktseiten bis zur Demo-Buchung und eigenständigen Registrierung.

  • Du treibst einen kontinuierlichen A/B-Testprozess voran: Ideen entwickeln, Tests planen, live bringen, auswerten und weiterentwickeln. Laufende Experimente gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Mit Analytics, Heatmaps und Verhaltensanalysen identifizierst du Hürden und Potenziale entlang der Nutzerreise, unter anderem mit Amplitude und Tracking-Daten.

  • Du führst ein umfassendes CRO-Audit der deutschen Website durch und vergleichst Funnel, Preisseite und Startseite mit führenden B2B-Websites.

2. Die deutsche Website als Produkt weiterentwickeln

  • Du verantwortest die Roadmap der deutschen Website und priorisierst nach Wirkung und Umsetzbarkeit.

  • Du entwickelst das Portal für Steuerkanzleien, die Marketplace-Integration und den Demo-Buchungsprozess für den deutschen Markt weiter.

  • Du verantwortest unser CMS Contentful: von einer klaren Struktur über wiederverwendbare Komponenten bis zum Aufbau neuer Seiten.

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering verantwortest du den gesamten Self-Service-Registrierungsprozess für Deutschland: das deutsche Formular, die automatische Ergänzung von Unternehmensdaten und eindeutige Unternehmenszuordnung über Northdata, die Datenübertragung an Salesforce und die Kontoerstellung über die Produkt-API.

3. Die Umsetzung im Team vorantreiben

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von UX, Engineering und Data – mit einem priorisierten Backlog, klaren Spezifikationen, konsequenter Nachverfolgung und Qualitätssicherung.

  • Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

  • Du koordinierst Content, Product Marketing und Lokalisierung: von der KI-gestützten Übersetzung über die Prüfung durch Muttersprachler bis zur Integration ins CMS.

  • Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

4. Teams und Stakeholder zusammenbringen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit SEO, SEA, Content, Product Marketing, Product, Legal und dem deutschen Marktteam zusammen – unter anderem an Landingpages zu RFE, Compte Pro und E-Rechnung.

  • Du bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs und gewinnst ihre Unterstützung, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

  • Du kommunizierst Prioritäten, Zeitpläne und wichtige Neuerungen klar und teamübergreifend.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung mit messbarer Wirkung: Du hast 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management oder in der Conversion-Rate-Optimierung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS- oder B2C-Umfeld. Du hast Features von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet und kannst anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich dadurch verbessert hat.

  • Eigenständiger Umgang mit Daten und CRO-Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Amplitude, GA4, Contentsquare oder Hotjar. Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, erkennst Muster und leitest Hypothesen ab, ohne auf eine Analyse durch andere angewiesen zu sein.

  • Fundierte A/B-Testing-Kenntnisse: Du weißt, wie du die nötige Stichprobengröße bestimmst, eine klare Erfolgskennzahl definierst und typische Fehler vermeidest – etwa Tests aufgrund vorläufiger Ergebnisse zu früh zu beenden oder mit zu kleinen Stichproben zu arbeiten.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Du schreibst präzise Briefings für Designer, erklärst Priorisierungsentscheidungen auch gegenüber skeptischen Stakeholdern und präsentierst Ergebnisse verständlich für ein nichttechnisches Publikum.

  • Sprachkenntnisse und Marktverständnis: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder vergleichbarem Niveau und kennst den deutschen Markt. Für die internationale Zusammenarbeit bringst du verhandlungssicheres Englisch mit. Französisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

jobs.title: Product Owner / Business Analyst / AMOA (H/F)
jobs.description:
E-Finances développe et commercialise des logiciels de gestion financière utilisées par des entreprises en France et à l'international depuis 25 ans. Nos outils couvrent la gestion de trésorerie, les rapprochements bancaires et comptables, ainsi que la validation et la transmission sécurisée des paiements vers les banques (EBICS, SWIFT).  

Nous cherchons un(e) Product Owner, Business Analyst ou AMOA pour prendre en charge le backlog fonctionnel de nos produits. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe R&D de quatre développeurs et vous êtes rattaché(e) au responsable R&D. 

Ce que vous ferez 

  • Organiser le backlog produit, proposer les priorités et le tenir à jour. 
  • Qualifier les demandes et les anomalies remontées par le support et les clients, et proposer la suite à donner. 
  • Rédiger des tickets clairs et complets (user stories, critères d'acceptation), prêts à être développés. 
  • Écrire et tenir à jour les spécifications fonctionnelles et les règles métier. 
  • Suivre l'évolution des normes bancaires et leur impact sur nos produits. 
  • Animer les rituels agiles : daily, refinement, sprint planning, revue de sprint et rétrospective. 
  • Préparer et réaliser les recettes fonctionnelles (tests manuels), puis coordonner les mises en production avec la R&D. 
  • Documenter le paramétrage, en lien avec le support, et contribuer aux notes de version. 
  • Contribuer à la feuille de route fonctionnelle des produits, avec le responsable R&D. 

Vous êtes seul(e) sur ce rôle, mais pas isolé(e) : vous démarrez sur le produit principal, avec l'appui du responsable R&D et de collègues qui connaissent très bien les produits et les clients, puis vous élargissez progressivement votre périmètre.  

Votre profil 

Idéalement vous disposez d’expérience en gestion financière, incluant par exemple la gestion de trésorerie ou la comptabilité.  

Vous avez aussi : 

  • un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, à l'écrit comme à l'oral 
  • l'envie de questionner les demandes et de proposer des solutions utiles aux clients 
  • de la rigueur : vous vérifiez avant d'affirmer 
  • de la curiosité pour le fonctionnement d'un logiciel : droits, données, paramétrage 
  • une expérience en recette ou en test 
  • la pratique de Jira et Confluence 
  • l'habitude d'utiliser des outils d'IA au quotidien 
  • l'anglais écrit, nos produits et leur documentation existent aussi en anglais 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre 

  • Des produits concrets, utilisés chaque jour par nos clients, dans un domaine exigeant (réglementation, sécurité). 
  • Un rôle où vous avez la main sur l'organisation du backlog et de la documentation produit. 
  • Une autonomie croissante dans les décisions fonctionnelles et la priorisation, à mesure que vous maîtrisez les produits. 
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec des échanges directs avec la direction, la R&D, le consulting et le support. 

Le processus de recrutement 

Quatre étapes : 

  1. Un premier échange d'environ 30 minutes avec le responsable R&D & IT et le responsable consulting. 
  1. Une étude de cas sur place, d'environ 1h30. 
  1. Une rencontre avec l'équipe. 
  1. Un dernier échange avec la direction.  

Infos pratiques 

  • Contrat : CDI, statut cadre. 
  • Lieu : Carquefou, en périphérie de Nantes. Une proximité géographique (moins d'une heure de trajet) est nécessaire pour venir régulièrement sur site.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Apaleo and the role

Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

What you'll be up to

  • Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.
  • Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.
  • Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.
  • Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.
  • Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.
  • Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.
  • Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

What you'll bring

You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

Required experience and competencies

  • Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.
  • Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.
  • Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.
  • Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.
  • Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.
  • An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

Nice to have

  • Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.
  • Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.
  • Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work.

Don't tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

 

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschlandticket.
  • Team connection. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your work will directly shape our platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible.

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

jobs.title: Lead Delivery /Senior Project Manager (F/H)
jobs.description:
LE CONTEXTE :

Fondée en 2017 par des ingénieurs de CentraleSupélec, ILLUIN Technology est une scale-up française en pleine effervescence de plus de 200 passionnés.

Notre mission ? Déployer l'IA et les solutions digitales de pointe à grande échelle, avec une culture de l’excellence forgée sur le plateau de Paris-Saclay.

Notre force repose sur une double approche unique :

  • MAKE : Des réalisations tech sur-mesure en GenAI, Data Science et Software Engineering.

  • BUY : Une suite de produits propriétaires de pointe (Dialogue, Automate, Analyze) orchestrée par notre plateforme low-code nAixt.

Propulsés par une croissance ultra-dynamique (15 M€ de CA en 2025 et une récente levée de fonds), nous structurons notre département Delivery. Nous recherchons un(e) leader capable d'allier rigueur opérationnelle et excellence technologique.

VOTRE RÔLE :

Rattaché(e) directement au pôle Delivery, vous occuperez un poste pivot de Lead Delivery / Senior Project Manager. Véritable "Leader de terrain", vous mènerez de front plusieurs projets complexes engagés au forfait dans un univers Data / IA stimulant, tout en devenant l’artisan de l'industrialisation de nos processus internes.

Le match parfait : Vous disposez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience, dont au moins 5 ans passés à piloter des projets au forfait au sein d'une ESN, le tout porté par une solide culture Data / IA.

VOS MISSIONS :

jobs.description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As Hardware Technical Program Manager (TPM), you will serve as the central technical liaison driving joint vehicle programs between our engineering teams and Volkswagen, Audi, and Porsche. Based out of our Berlin hub, you will bridge the gap between our US-based core engineering teams and our European brand partners, aligning complex hardware requirements, program roadmaps, and architectural decisions.

Rather than managing tier-level supply chains, your focus is entirely collaborative and strategic: orchestrating alignment across brand engineering groups, manufacturing plants, and internal hardware teams to turn ambitious vehicle programs into production reality.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the hardware integration partner for VW, Audi, and Porsche in parallel, keeping alignment across the three brands on requirements, schedules, and decisions.

  • Own hardware integration schedules, milestones, and readiness gates across assigned vehicle programs, from prototype builds (EVT, DVT) through production validation.

  • Drive engineering change management, including Program Change Requests (PCRs), impact assessments, and approval through partner boards.

  • Coordinate with internal hardware development and validation teams, and bridge the time difference between the US home base and European partners.

  • Track and close hardware issues and open action items, with clear owners and due dates.

  • Lead cost-reduction initiatives on hardware platforms, including proposal reviews and status reporting.

  • Represent hardware integration in program reviews, quality boards, and steering meetings, preparing decisions and clear status updates for leadership.

  • Maintain the Brand Technical Responsible (BTV) interface, collecting partner feedback and turning it into prioritized actions.

  • Help build and grow the European partnering team over time, including hiring and onboarding as the program scales.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong background in hardware development and/or hardware validation, with enough technical depth to challenge engineering decisions and follow test results.

  • Generalist profile: comfortable moving between hardware design, validation, program management, and partner alignment.

  • Experience in automotive or another safety-critical industry, ideally across development phases (EVT, DVT, PVT).

  • Fluent German and very good English, both written and spoken, for daily work with brand partners and with colleagues in the US.

  • High stress resistance: able to keep priorities clear and communicate calmly during tight deadlines, escalations, and launch pressure.

  • Agile working style: experience running work in sprints or iterative cycles, adapting plans quickly, and working in cross-functional teams.

  • Comfortable working across time zones, with regular overlap with US colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with OEM partner programs, ideally with multiple brands in parallel.

  • Experience with automotive change management processes and PCR or ECR workflows.

  • Familiarity with zonal architectures, vehicle networking, or ECU platforms such as XMM, RFM, or VAS.

  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) is a plus.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Core UX
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

🎨 The Core UX task force

Core UX is a task force inside the Scale tribe. It owns the part of Joko that every single user touches, on every platform: navigation, account and login, and the cross-cutting features that make the app work — cash back collection, redeem, favouriting, search, and the map. It also owns the Care experience and, importantly, performance and reliability across the board.

That scope runs across an unusually wide surface area: the mobile app on iOS and Android, the Chrome, Firefox and Safari desktop extensions, the Mobile Safari Extension, and the web app. Every other task force builds on the foundations Core UX lays down. That makes the role high-leverage and demanding in equal measure: a latency regression or a broken login flow here is felt everywhere at once.

The task force is a small, autonomous team: a Product Manager who owns it, a Product Designer, and software engineers.

🎯 What you will do

As Product Manager for the Core UX task force, you own it. That means a slice of Joko's core cross-platform experience end to end, with performance and reliability as a permanent thread. You will report to Damien, who leads the Scale tribe, and work with a Product Designer and software engineers.

  • Core experience ownership: You will own core surfaces — navigation, onboarding and login, cash back collection, search, redeem — from problem framing through spec, delivery, and post-launch monitoring. These are used by millions of people daily, which means small changes carry real weight.

  • Cross-platform trade-offs: Mobile, desktop extensions, Mobile Safari Extension and web app each have their own constraints — iOS restrictions, app store review, browser APIs. You will decide what ships where, what stays consistent, and where platform-specific divergence is worth the cost.

  • Performance & reliability: App latency, silent degradations, and regressions caught too late are a standing part of the mandate. You will define what good looks like, get it monitored, and own reliability as a product feature.

  • Foundations work: A meaningful share of the roadmap is foundational — design systems, codebase consolidation, tooling that makes the whole Product & Engineering org faster. You will make the case for that work in terms of user and business outcomes.

  • Delight & personalization: Core UX also owns whether Joko feels good to use. You will run discovery on the experiences that make people come back, and ship improvements to the moments that matter most.

  • Stakeholder alignment: Because every other task force depends on your surfaces, you will spend real time arbitrating between their needs and the health of the core, and saying no in a way people accept.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products, ideally mobile apps. You have owned a scope end to end and driven your own roadmap.

  • Scale sensibility: You have worked on products with a large user base and you understand what changes when a decision affects millions of people rather than thousands.

  • Craft & UX judgment: You care about how things feel. You can tell a functional experience from a genuinely good one, and you push for the second.

  • Technical fluency: You are comfortable in a technical environment — platform constraints, performance, release mechanics — and you can hold your own with engineers on trade-offs. Coding is not required.

  • Data fluency: You define metrics, instrument them, and use them. You are comfortable digging into numbers yourself to find where an experience is leaking.

  • AI fluency: You are hands-on with AI tools in your own product work. At Joko this is expected daily, across the whole company.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are good at alignment, prioritization, and making trade-offs explicit when several teams want incompatible things from the same surface.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €64K – €104K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform tribe

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

  • Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

  • Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

  • Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

  • Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt.

  • Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction.

  • Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

  • AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place.

  • Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you.

  • Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

  • Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

Engine is where Juno meets the user. It owns the conversation itself: how someone expresses a vague intent, how the assistant narrows it down, and how a recommendation is presented so that it is actually trusted. Nobody has settled what a great shopping conversation looks like, so there are no patterns to borrow and the answers have to be found by building and testing.

The task force is a small, autonomous team: a Product Manager who owns it, a Product Designer, and software engineers. This role is its first Product Manager, so the scope, the standards, and the way the team works are yours to define.

You will design for hallucinations, unexpected outputs, and edge cases: what the fallback is, what the model gets fed, what the user sees when it goes wrong. This is a large part of the craft in this role.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager D365 CRM
Lead Product Manager - Business Lines
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

💲The Business Lines tribe

Business Lines owns Joko's current revenue engine across three product lines, each run by a dedicated task force:

  • 🌐 Online, Joko's historical core, covers the app, web app and browser extensions. Its challenge is to make sure users discover the right offers, clicks are tracked, purchases are attributed, commissions are approved, and cash back lands reliably.

  • 💳 In-Store owns card-linked offers, where users link their bank card and earn cash back when they pay at partner merchants in physical stores. It is a very different product line, closer to banking, payment integrations and merchant operations.

  • 🎁 Gift Cards lets users buy or earn gift cards from a catalog of brands, and already represents a significant and fast-growing share of company revenue.

Across these scopes, the tribe works on hard, high-impact product problems: improving catch and track rates, reducing funnel leaks, adapting to privacy and browser changes, strengthening payment and affiliate flows, and creating better customer experiences.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Business Lines tribe, your mission is to grow and strengthen the revenue Joko runs on today, across Online, In-Store and Gift Cards. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, lead the Product Managers who own each task force, and personally take the calls that cut across them.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will arbitrate between three task forces with very different mechanics and very different economics, decide where the next engineer and the next euro go, and defend those trade-offs in front of leadership.

  • Own the revenue chain end to end: Catch rate and track rate decide whether a purchase becomes revenue, and a fraction of a point there is worth hundreds of thousands of euros a year. You will make sure the tribe knows exactly where the chain leaks, sizes each lever properly, and prioritises accordingly.

  • Go deep where it matters: Affiliate tracking and attribution, card-linked payment integrations, checkout and coupon flows. You will not be the PM writing every spec, but you will be expected to understand these mechanics well enough to challenge a diagnosis and make the final call.

  • Champion the user experience: You will stay close to user needs and pain points across each business line, and make sure the tribe turns them into dedicated features, sharp product improvements and astonishing customer experiences.

  • Navigate the structural challenges: Privacy regulation, browser tracking restrictions, payment ecosystem changes and last-click competition keep changing the rules. You will build the product strategy that keeps the business healthy as conditions shift, rather than reacting to each change as it lands.

  • Lead and grow the PMs: You will manage and mentor the Product Managers on Online, In-Store and Gift Cards, set the bar on funnel analysis, experimentation and delivery, and grow people who can own a revenue stream on their own.

  • Define what healthy looks like: You will set the metrics that matter for each business line, hold the tribe to them, and be accountable for the tribe's contribution to company revenue.

  • Work across the company: You will partner with the B2B teams who own merchant relationships, with Care on the user pain that untracked transactions create, with Data, and directly with the affiliate and payment partners themselves.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers, ideally on consumer products. Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, payments, adtech or affiliate marketing is a strong plus.

  • Data fluency: This is the criterion that carries the most weight here. You can interrogate a funnel yourself, break a metric into its components, and tell a real signal from noise. Much of this job is diagnosis before it is delivery, and you need to be able to do it yourself, not just ask for it.

  • Business sense: You think in revenue, margin and trade-offs. You can size a lever in euros before committing a team to it, and you are comfortable being accountable for a number in front of the exec team.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Technical appetite: You want to understand how the tracking and the payment integrations actually work: browser behaviour, cookies, redirects, backend pipelines, card networks. Coding is not required, but you will be close to the mechanics every week.

  • Experimentation: You have run real A/B tests, you know how to design one that answers a question, and you can tell a team when theirs will not.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no, with merchants, partners and internal teams alike.

  • Resilience: Much of this domain sits outside your control: browsers change, merchants change, regulation changes, competitors change. Problems that never fully close are what motivate you. If you are looking for a blank page and a 0-to-1 product, this is not that seat: this is a mature business with real revenue on the line every day.

  • AI fluency: You are hands-on with AI tools in your own product work. At Joko this is expected daily, across the whole company.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

jobs.title: Product Owner Gemeentepas
jobs.description:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.

In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.

Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

  • Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

  • Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

  • Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

  • Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

  • Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

  • Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

  • Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

  • Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric


Hier starten jouw kansen  
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien. 

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.

This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

  • Partner Engagement & Insight:

    • Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

    • Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

    • Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve

  • Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace, or dealer-facing products

  • Familiarity with gamification or engagement loop design in a B2B context

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

Fixed-term contract 6 months (maternity cover)

London — hybrid, with regular presence in our London office

Delta Capita is a global provider of managed services, technology and consulting to the financial services industry. Design sits at the centre of how we build our products. Our team shapes the interfaces our clients and their customers use every day.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead UX/UI Designer to cover a 6-month period of maternity leave, starting November 2026 and based in our London office. You will own the design of complex, multi-stakeholder products end to end - from early problem solving through to prototypes and production-ready UI. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams on a day-to-day basis, with support from senior stakeholders as needed.

You will be comfortable making confident design decisions, shipping in short cycles, and iterating once real feedback arrives.You will be responsible for leading other junior designers in the team, to make help them make decisions, give feedback and make sure work is delivered to a high standard and on time.


Key responsibilities

  • Own complex projects end to end. Take full design accountability for one or more product workstreams, from early discovery through wireframes, prototypes and final UI specification.

  • Run and facilitate workshops. Across teams and features, driving strategic alignment.

  • Support junior designers. Set direction, review work, run critique sessions and support the day-to-day development of junior members of the design team.

  • Partner with product and engineering. Work closely with product managers to shape requirements, and with developers to ensure designs are implemented faithfully and are technically feasible.

  • Deliver at pace. Prioritise, break large problems into shippable increments and keep momentum across parallel workstreams.

  • Uphold accessibility and quality. Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards and our internal quality bar before handover.

Essential skills and experience

  • Proven track record as a lead UX/UI designer, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex, large-scale digital products.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Sketch, including symbols, libraries and shared styles.

  • Strong prototyping ability - you can move from a rough concept to a testable interactive prototype quickly.

  • Demonstrable experience mentoring or line-managing junior designers.

  • Confident collaborating with product managers, engineers, business stakeholders and, where relevant, clients.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can explain and defend design decisions to non-designers.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience designing for fintech, banking or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Familiarity with Sketch

  • Experience running user research and usability testing directly.
